description: Searchable manifest for the product-truth store. artifacts[] is authoritative; entity_registry gates entity names; by_component / by_entity / by_flow are derived indexes (regenerate with scripts/validate_product_truth.py --build). See README.md for the search + add-vs-create protocol.

artifacts.title: Customer buys a plant
artifacts.summary: Browse → detail → cart → checkout → confirmed, with a notify-me path for sold-out plants.

artifacts.title: Customer tracks an order
artifacts.summary: My orders → order detail → track shipment. Reuses the catalog dataset (extend, not duplicate).

artifacts.title: Define a feature the product-truth way
artifacts.summary: Say what you want → classify → draft mock data → draft mockups → assemble flow → review & approve (ACs generated from the flow's steps).

artifacts.title: How a flow renders in the Atlas
artifacts.summary: Read the flow + index JSON → resolve each step to its AC's live work_status → draw the graph on /flows.

artifacts.title: How product-truth links are generated and kept truthful
artifacts.summary: Build the AC work_status map → derive each step's impl_status + roll up impl_summary → invert flow→AC edges into by_ac → write product_truth back-refs onto ACs → validate on drift.

artifacts.title: Exploring product-truth flows in the Atlas
artifacts.summary: Open the Flows view → filter by source and kind → select a flow to render its graph → open a step for its ACs' live status, mock records and mockup → jump from an AC to the flows it appears in.

artifacts.title: Product-truth in the leafcutter architecture
artifacts.summary: Store lives beside the AC store → the Atlas reads it live and renders flows → agents produce & extend the artifacts.

artifacts.title: How an acceptance criterion is born, built & retired
artifacts.summary: Triage → author (PO/BA/IT PO) → approve → scan → generate ticket → mark done, with govern / backfill / re-home / retire update paths.

artifacts.title: How a ticket is built (the phase chain)
artifacts.summary: Dispatch → architect → test (red) → code (green) → scope → review → ac-gate → commit → pr, with the agent + produces/consumes handoff on each step and a blocker adjudication branch.

artifacts.title: How the draft artifacts are authored (the product-truth agents)
artifacts.summary: classify (which artifacts?) → search (add vs create) → mock-data agent → mockup agent → flow agent → business-analyst derives ACs, with decision branches for mockup+data / mock-data-only / mockup-only / none.

artifacts.title: Deliver a feature end-to-end
artifacts.summary: L0 journey: plan (define-a-feature) -> build (how-acs-are-built) -> finalize (finalize-feature). Each stage drills into its own pipeline flow.

artifacts.title: Finalize a feature (merge & close)
artifacts.summary: The real finalize-feature.js pipeline: baseline -> open PR -> merge main (HALT on conflict) -> post-merge tests + triage (HALT on regression) -> close ACs -> merge PR (gated) -> archive + remove worktree.

artifacts.title: Inside python-coder (the coder's internal workflow)
artifacts.summary: Agent-altitude drill-down beneath the code step: load conventions -> implement against red -> doc-enforcer -> complexity reduction -> run until green -> record sign-off.

artifacts.title: Fern & Fig catalog
artifacts.summary: The canonical Plant / Customer / Order dataset for the plant-shop sample.

artifacts.title: Plant listing
artifacts.summary: The Fern & Fig catalogue landing screen — a grid of plant cards with price + stock badge, populated from the catalog Plant records. THE gold-reference mockup.

artifacts.title: Plant detail
artifacts.summary: STUB — one plant's photo, price and stock with add-to-cart. Registered so the buy-a-plant flow's detail step resolves; HTML not yet drawn.

artifacts.title: Cart
artifacts.summary: STUB — plant, quantity, unit price and running total before payment. Registered so the buy-a-plant flow's cart step resolves; HTML not yet drawn.

artifacts.title: Checkout
artifacts.summary: STUB — confirm details and pay, creating an Order. Registered so the buy-a-plant flow's checkout step resolves; HTML not yet drawn.

artifacts.title: Order confirmation
artifacts.summary: STUB — order number and paid items after payment. Registered so the buy-a-plant flow's confirmed step resolves; HTML not yet drawn.

artifacts.title: Notify me
artifacts.summary: STUB — notify-me action for an out-of-stock plant. Registered so the buy-a-plant flow's notify branch resolves; HTML not yet drawn.

artifacts.title: My orders
artifacts.summary: STUB — list of past orders with number, item, total and status. Registered so the track-an-order flow's orders step resolves; HTML not yet drawn.

artifacts.title: Order detail
artifacts.summary: STUB — one order's item, quantity, total, payment status and date. Registered so the track-an-order flow's orderDetail step resolves; HTML not yet drawn.

artifacts.title: Track shipment
artifacts.summary: STUB — current delivery stage for an order. Registered so the track-an-order flow's track step resolves; HTML not yet drawn.
